meta.title: Final Fantasy IX
meta.art_style: Hand-painted watercolor fantasy with warm golden tones, lush environments, and chibi-proportioned characters inspired by classic JRPG art. Soft lighting, rich colors, storybook aesthetic.
meta.description: A sweeping tale of identity, belonging, and the bonds that give life meaning. Follow Zidane and friends from the kingdom of Alexandria across two worlds as they confront a cosmic threat born from one man's fear of mortality.

characters.name: Zidane Tribal
characters.description: A cheerful young man with a monkey tail, sandy blonde hair, and a roguish grin. Wears a sleeveless teal vest and white shirt. Quick on his feet and quicker with words.
characters.backstory: A Genome from Terra raised on Gaia by the Tantalus theater troupe. Doesn't know his true origins but carries an innate warmth that draws people to him.

locations.name: Alexandria Castle
locations.description: A grand white stone castle with towering spires, surrounded by a bustling medieval city. Colorful banners flutter in the wind. A theater stage is set up in the courtyard.
locations.background_prompt: Grand medieval castle with white spires, bustling courtyard with theater stage, colorful banners, warm golden sunset lighting, watercolor fantasy style

locations.description: A dark, twisted woodland where gnarled trees seem to reach out with clawed branches. Bioluminescent fungi cast an eerie green glow. The forest itself seems alive and hostile.
locations.background_prompt: Dark twisted forest, gnarled trees with claw-like branches, bioluminescent green fungi, misty atmosphere, ominous, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Ice Cavern
locations.description: A frozen cave system with crystalline ice formations. Icicles hang from the ceiling like chandeliers. The walls shimmer with an ethereal blue light.
locations.background_prompt: Frozen crystal cave, massive icicle formations, shimmering blue light reflecting off ice walls, cold ethereal atmosphere, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Village of Dali
locations.description: A quaint farming village with windmills and thatched-roof cottages. Beneath its peaceful exterior lies a secret underground factory producing Black Mage soldiers.
locations.background_prompt: Charming farming village, windmills, thatched cottages, rolling green hills, blue sky, hidden dark secret beneath, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Lindblum Grand Castle
locations.description: A sprawling industrial city built into a mountain, with airship docks and steam-powered machinery. The grand castle sits at the peak, home to the jovial Regent Cid.
locations.background_prompt: Massive steampunk-fantasy city carved into a mountain, airship docks, steam pipes, grand castle at summit, bustling market districts, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Burmecia
locations.description: The rain-soaked city of the dragon knights, now lying in ruins. Perpetual rain falls on crumbling stone towers. Bodies of Burmecian soldiers litter the streets.
locations.background_prompt: Ruined medieval city in perpetual rain, crumbling stone towers, wet cobblestone streets, fallen soldiers, melancholic atmosphere, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Cleyra Settlement
locations.description: An ancient tree-city protected by a magical sandstorm. Beautiful wooden platforms and bridges wind through the enormous trunk. A place of peace about to be shattered.
locations.background_prompt: Massive ancient tree city, wooden platforms and bridges spiraling up trunk, magical sandstorm swirling outside, golden warm interior light, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Alexandria Harbor
locations.description: The coastal harbor of Alexandria where warships and merchant vessels dock. Brahne meets her end on the sandy beach nearby.
locations.background_prompt: Coastal harbor with medieval warships, sandy beach, dramatic sunset, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Outer Continent

locations.background_prompt: Wild jungle continent, ancient stone ruins overgrown with vines, dramatic cliffs, distant dwarven village, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Iifa Tree
locations.description: A colossal tree that is the source of the Mist covering the land. Its roots plunge deep underground, draining life energy. Pulsing veins of sickly green energy run through its bark.
locations.background_prompt: Colossal corrupted tree, pulsing green veins of energy, roots plunging underground, sickly mist emanating, dark and foreboding, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Terra
locations.description: An alien world bathed in blue light. Crystalline structures and empty Genome vessels line silent streets. Beautiful but lifeless — a dying civilization preserved in stasis.
locations.background_prompt: Alien world bathed in blue light, crystalline architecture, empty streets with dormant humanoid vessels, hauntingly beautiful, watercolor fantasy style

locations.name: Crystal World
locations.description: The core of existence itself — a vast void filled with floating crystal platforms. Space bends and warps. The Crystal, source of all life, pulses at the center.
locations.background_prompt: Abstract void with floating crystal platforms, warped space, massive pulsing crystal at center, cosmic colors, ethereal and otherworldly, watercolor fantasy style

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: Well well, looks like the princess wants to be kidnapped!

lines.speaker: Garnet
lines.text: Please, take me away from here. My mother... she's changed.

lines.speaker: Steiner
lines.text: Princess! I cannot allow this! These are common thieves!

lines.speaker: Garnet
lines.text: Steiner, I must go. Something terrible is happening in this kingdom.

lines.speaker: Vivi
lines.text: Those... those things in the factory. They look just like me.

lines.speaker: Vivi
lines.text: Am I... am I just a weapon too? Was I made to hurt people?

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: You're not a weapon, Vivi. You're our friend. That's what matters.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: My home... what have they done to my home?

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: Freya, I'm sorry. We'll make them pay for this.

lines.speaker: Freya
lines.text: Kuja... I saw him here. He was watching the destruction like it was entertainment.

lines.speaker: Garland
lines.text: Welcome home, Zidane. You are a Genome — created by me, to serve Terra.

lines.speaker: Garland
lines.text: You were meant to be the Angel of Death. The catalyst for Terra's rebirth.

lines.speaker: Zidane
lines.text: I don't care where I came from. My friends — THEY are my home.

story_beats.description: Kidnap Garnet, escape through Evil Forest and Ice Cavern, discover Dali factory
Reach Lindblum, learn of Brahne's war plans
Witness the fall of Burmecia and destruction of Cleyra
Rescue Garnet from Alexandria, Brahne dies
Journey to Terra, learn the truth about Zidane and Kuja
Final confrontation at the Crystal World
